title: Angry & Stubborn: Woman Goes Nuts After Being Cuffed
description:
On June 16th, 2023, officers were dispatched to arrest a person with a warrant. As soon as they approached the residence, they observed the suspect trying to avoid them, but later she complied and came out to talk to them. She soon started breaking down emotionally. Here’s how the events unfolded. She continued to cry loudly in front of the officers. Suddenly, the woman began yelling and screaming from inside the police unit. The female continued to yell while being transported to jail. Even in jail, the woman showed no signs of calming down.  The female had a previous warrant and was additionally charged with resisting arrest.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
